description: Return the value of a bound variable. Optional default applies only when the name is not bound — not when the value is undefined. If unbound and no default is given, the result is undefined. Object/array defaults get a mutable memory face (issues #110 / #17); other defaults are cloned.

parameters.description: Name of variable to get. Optionally qualifier::name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Value to return only if the name is not bound. Isolated when used (object/array face; otherwise clone).
parameters.name: defaultValue

returns.description: Bound variable value, or default / undefined if unbound.
